newsitem.title: USA: Florida baby dies after alcohol put in her bottle.
newsitem.headline: Florida baby dies after alcohol put in her bottle.

text.p: An infant girl died in a Florida hospital Wednesday after suffering for a month from poisoning by alcohol that authorities suspect was put into her formula bottle, a hospital spokeswoman said.
Teresia Terrell, of Kissimmee, was pronounced dead at 5:45 a.m. EST at Florida Hospital in Orlando, the spokeswoman said. She was about six months old.
The child was admitted to the hospital on Feb. 6, most of the time breathing only with the assistance of a respirator. She died after her parents decided to remove her from life support.
Authorities believe the alcohol she drank had been mixed into her formula by someone who might have believed it would help her sleep.
Police said no arrest had been made in connection with the child's death.
